Welcome to a world where time is ultimate currency!⁣⁣ 👀 
⁣⁣
— You stop aging at 25, but here’s the catch: you’re genetically-engineered to live only one more year, unless you can buy your way out of it. The rich “earn” decades at a time (remaining at age 25), becoming essentially immortal, while the rest beg, borrow or steal enough hours to make it through the day. —⁣
⁣⁣
Andrew Niccol came up with this concept while making Gattaca (1997). He considered its implications so enormous that he decided it deserved an entirely separate film. Interestingly, the movie was originally titled I’m.mortal, a play on the words “I’m mortal” and “immortal.” However, a naming conflict with another film forced Niccol to change the title, first to Now and eventually to In Time. Niccol also deliberately chose 25 as the age when people stop aging, partly because it’s around the age when the brain’s frontal lobe reaches full maturity.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
